description: Source code implementing DNS HTTPS record RDATA parsing and handling, including classes for alias and service forms, with functions for parsing and validation of DNS record data.

classes.name: HttpsRecordRdata
classes.description: Base class representing DNS HTTPS record RDATA, with methods for parsing, equality, and type identification.

classes.name: AliasFormHttpsRecordRdata
classes.description: Derived class representing alias form of HTTPS record RDATA, containing alias name.

classes.name: ServiceFormHttpsRecordRdata
classes.description: Derived class representing service form of HTTPS record RDATA, containing service parameters such as priority, service name, ALPN IDs, IP hints, etc.

methods.name: HttpsRecordRdata::Parse
methods.description: Static method to parse raw data into an HttpsRecordRdata object, distinguishing alias and service forms based on priority.

methods.name: AliasFormHttpsRecordRdata::Parse
methods.description: Static method to parse data into an alias form HTTPS record RDATA, extracting alias name.

methods.name: ServiceFormHttpsRecordRdata::Parse
methods.description: Static method to parse data into a service form HTTPS record RDATA, extracting service parameters.
